english.title: Driver failing to deliver drivers record book to employer

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employee-driver who had completed a weekly record sheet for the week ending **(..SPECIFY DATE..), failed to deliver your driver's record book (including the duplicate of the weekly record sheet which had been completed) to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), the employer who issued or should have issued it to you, within

(A)_[a period of 7 days from the date when the weekly record sheet was completed]_
(B)_[the period required by your employer]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(1) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was employed by **(..SPECIFY EMPLOYER..) as a driver of a goods vehicle, and was the holder of a driver's record book, failed to deliver the

(A)_[record book]_
(B)_[duplicate weekly record sheet]_
(C)_[record book and duplicate weekly record sheet]_

to that employer.
